name: Kingpin
summary: The crime boss who looks soft and hits like a truck. Wilson Fisk runs New York's underworld from behind a respectable front, and he became Daredevil's archenemy after starting out against Spider-Man.
origin: The Kingpin is what you get when a crime boss looks soft and turns out to be a wall. Stan Lee and John Romita Sr. introduced Wilson Fisk in The Amazing Spider-Man #50 in 1967 as the man running New York's underworld, and he spent his first years as a Spider-Man problem. Then in 1981 Frank Miller pulled him into Daredevil, where he found his real calling as Matt Murdock's archenemy, a patient planner who ruins lives through the system instead of with his fists. He can still use his fists: that huge frame is mostly muscle, and he fights with frightening skill. Bullseye may be Daredevil's craziest enemy, but Fisk is his worst.
powers: Huge strength and toughness, mostly muscle
Trick cane with a laser and sleeping gas

storyline.title: The crime boss
storyline.beat: Wilson Fisk first appears in The Amazing Spider-Man #50 as the huge, calm boss who runs New York's organised crime.

storyline.title: Daredevil's nemesis
storyline.beat: Frank Miller moves the Kingpin into Daredevil's world, where he becomes Matt Murdock's greatest enemy.

storyline.title: Destroying Murdock
storyline.beat: Fisk learns Daredevil's identity and methodically destroys his life, only to watch Matt rise again.

storyline.title: Elected
storyline.beat: Fisk runs for mayor of New York and wins, gaining legal power over the heroes he once fought from the shadows.

storyline.title: Outlawing heroes
storyline.beat: As mayor, Fisk bans vigilante activity and hunts the city's heroes.

gossip.text: Kingpin is just a fat man in a suit.
gossip.truth: The comics describe his bulk as mostly muscle, and he is a dangerous fighter.

gossip.text: He debuted as a Spider-Man villain, not a Daredevil one. Frank Miller moved him over in 1981.
Michael Clarke Duncan played him in 2003. Vincent D'Onofrio took the role in Daredevil and later Hawkeye.
He became the elected mayor of New York in 2017.
His wife Vanessa is often his one weak spot.

quiz.q: Which hero did the Kingpin first fight?
quiz.why: He debuted in The Amazing Spider-Man #50.

quiz.q: Which office did Fisk win in 2017?
What is the Kingpin's real name?

theme.tagline: Runs the city with a cane and a spreadsheet.

timeline.title: The crime boss in the white suit
timeline.note: The Amazing Spider-Man #50 introduces Wilson Fisk, a huge mob boss who is all muscle under the bulk.

timeline.title: Cartoon crime lord
timeline.note: Fisk joins the villains of the 1967 Spider-Man cartoon in his first TV appearance.

timeline.title: Daredevil's arch-enemy
timeline.note: Frank Miller pulls Fisk into Daredevil #170 and makes him Matt Murdock's main foe for good.

timeline.title: Born Again
timeline.note: Fisk learns Daredevil's identity and methodically wrecks his life, in one of Marvel's most famous stories.

timeline.title: John Rhys-Davies plays Fisk
timeline.note: The Trial of the Incredible Hulk TV movie casts John Rhys-Davies as the Kingpin.

timeline.title: Michael Clarke Duncan's Fisk
timeline.note: The Daredevil movie casts Michael Clarke Duncan as a towering Kingpin.

timeline.title: Vincent D'Onofrio's Fisk
timeline.note: Netflix's Daredevil gives Fisk a soft voice and a terrifying temper, a definitive take on the role.

timeline.title: Mayor Fisk on Disney+
timeline.note: Daredevil: Born Again picks up with D'Onofrio's Fisk running New York City as mayor.
